abstract: Twenty-one patients with metastatic germ cell tumors achieved only partial clinical tumor regression following chemotherapy, and underwent surgical biopsy or resection of the residual tumor deposits. Sixteen (76%) are at present clinically disease-free after a median 30 + months (range 17-50 months) from the time of surgery, and five (24%) died after 9-29 months. Adverse prognostic signs were the finding of persistent cancer at histopathological examination of the resected tumor masses, and the presence of elevated serum tumor markers at the time of surgery. Postchemotherapy surgery in this setting provides tissue for the prognostically important histopathological examination on which a decision regarding further chemotherapy may be based. In addition, it provides tumor bulk reduction in the cases of differentiated teratoma and persistent cancer.
abstract_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍の患者21例は、化学療法後に臨床的に部分的な腫瘍縮小しか得られず、残存腫瘍巣に対し外科的生検または切除を受けた。16例(76%)は手術から中央値30か月以上(17～50か月)の時点で現在無病であり、5例(24%)は9～29か月後に死亡した。予後不良の徴候は、切除腫瘤の病理組織学的検査で持続性の癌が認められたこと、および手術時に血清腫瘍マーカーが上昇していたことであった。この状況での化学療法後手術は、その後の化学療法の判断の基礎となる予後上重要な病理組織学的検査のための組織を提供する。さらに、分化型奇形腫および持続性癌の症例では腫瘍量の減量をもたらす。
